source_cautions: Quotient homogeneity leaves a scaling zero direction. The literal all-nonzero language in NS Theorem 4 must be read with the scaling exclusion in (16). Our theorem is modulo positive scaling.

NS Lemma 3 fixed-alpha trace replacement cannot hold literally for a constant sequence of interior-supported tests. Our argument proves a joint alpha-to-infinity concentration limit in a common weighted space.
NS boundary gradient expansion cannot be joint-uniform when alpha(1-r) grows. Our exact-flux argument uses the saturated factor min(1,alpha(1-r)).
